questions.question: Explain why the volume of a 5 cm by 4 cm by 3 cm box is 60 cubic centimetres.
questions.expected_answer: The bottom layer has 4 rows of 5 cubes, which is 20 cubes. The box is 3 cm high, so there are 3 layers. 3 layers of 20 cubes is 60 cubes, so the volume is 60 cubic centimetres.

questions.question: A truck is packed 6 crates long, 4 crates wide and 3 crates high. How many crates are there?
questions.expected_answer: Each layer has 6 × 4 = 24 crates, and there are 3 layers, so there are 24 × 3 = 72 crates.

questions.question: Why is the volume of a cube with 3 cm edges not 9 cubic centimetres?
questions.expected_answer: 9 cubes is only one layer of 3 rows of 3. The cube is also 3 cm high, so there are 3 layers, and 3 × 9 = 27 cubic centimetres.
